name: repsandsteps-android
description: Android shell for the RepsAndSteps web app (Capacitor).

scripts.build:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.build:debug:unix: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.build:release:unix: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
